set.body: Acceptance criteria: interpolation, smoothing, projection, and fusion append inspectable lineage without erasing measured or prior derived origin; invalid observations do not acquire misleading derived origin; adjacent-fixation merging validates a non-negative gap, clock agreement, frame agreement, and source support, or operates on a stronger artifact that proves them; provenance and identity mutants fail.
set.title: Make sample lineage and event merging compositional
